title: Canned job warning lists inactive parts A to Z, separated by commas
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), a role that has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Create & Edit' and 'Delete'.
  • Inventory parts {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CANSORT-AB100), {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CANSORT-FF5507) and {Part-C} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CANSORT-MM20) are tracked at {Location-A} with 4 in their default bins and are inactive.
  • In A to Z order by part number the three come {Part-A}, then {Part-B}, then {Part-C}.
  • Inventory part {Part-D} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CANSORT-ZZ900) is tracked at {Location-A} with 4 in its default bin and is active.
  • Canned job {Canned-job-A} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST PL CANSORTSRC line") holds, in this order, {Part-C}, {Part-B}, {Part-A} and {Part-D}, one of each, saved while all four were active.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15440) at {Location-A} is open and has no lines.
custom_steps:
1. Open {Work-order-1}.
  2. Click "New Line".
  3. Type the start of {Canned-job-A} in Title.
  4. Pick the {Canned-job-A} suggestion.
  5. Click "Save & Close".
  6. Read the warning at the bottom right.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: The suggestion reads {Canned-job-A} with "Total Parts: 4".
  • Step 5: {Work-order-1} gets a new line {Canned-job-A} holding one part, {Part-D}. {Part-A}, {Part-B} and {Part-C} are not on it.
  • Step 6: Exactly one warning shows: "These parts are inactive and were not added: {Part-A}, {Part-B}, {Part-C}." The numbers are in A to Z order, not in the order the canned job holds them ({Part-C}, {Part-B}, {Part-A}), and each is separated from the next by a comma and a space.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S9-R10c, S9-R10, S9-R10b, S9-R9, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas boards 6.4 (A canned job that holds it) and 6.5 (The canned job leaves it out, one part only), 13 Oct copy. Product's answer of 13 Oct (Chris Ward, question 9): A to Z by part number, separated by ", ". SV-10822 does not yet carry S9-R10c (the PRD wins). Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R10c: “When two or more parts are left out, they are listed A to Z by part number, separated by ", ". Example: "These parts are inactive and were not added: AB-100, FF-5507."”
  • S9-R10: “When a canned job leaves out parts, the system shows one warning listing every part left out: "These parts are inactive and were not added: {part numbers}." The warning stays until the user closes it.”
  • S9-R10b: “The warning names each part by the inventory part's own number, as it shows on the Inactive tab, not by the number as typed in the canned job.”
  • S9-R9: “Applying a canned job adds the job without its inactive parts.”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Canned job leaves out inactive parts): “"These parts are inactive and were not added: {part numbers}." plus "The {fee} fee for {part number} was not added." for each fee left out | Warning toast, one per canned job, stays until closed”
